No first purchase

Listeners stay listeners

A couple binges your episodes, saves your posts, and then has two options: apply for the full program, or keep waiting. Most keep waiting, and the trust you built earns nothing yet.

Ad spend

Ads pay out only when someone applies

With ~10 ads live, every click that doesn’t apply today is spend you can’t get back. A low-ticket first step lets the front end pay for the ads.

Cold applications

Calls with couples who aren’t ready

Couples can apply straight from an ad or a post, before they understand your approach. That means more time on calls with people who were never going to start.

The couples who aren’t ready for your program today leave with a free episode, and nothing that moves them closer to working with you.

My recommendation

A $27 Fertility Foundations Kit between your free teaching and your program

You already teach through the podcast, your class and your ads. What’s missing is a small, self-paced product the 95% can buy today, with an order bump, an upsell and a downsell, and the application at the end for the couples who are ready for more. Your current ads can point at it, so the same spend starts paying for itself.

Questions

Before you start

Is this medical advice?

No. The kit is education. It doesn’t diagnose or treat anything, and it doesn’t replace care from your own doctor. It helps you understand the foundations and ask better questions.

Is it for both partners?

Yes. One lesson is just for him, and the planner is built to fill in together.

How long does it take?

Each lesson is short. Most couples go through the kit in a week or two, then use the 90-day planner.

Why is it only $27?

Because the first step should be easy to take. Start with the foundations, and decide later if you want personal support.

Script 1 · “Normal isn’t the full picture”

Body

“Many couples are only ever shown a handful of numbers. In my practice as a naturopath, we look at the wider picture: the cycle, nutrients, lifestyle, and both partners. I put the foundations I teach into five short lessons, so couples can understand them and ask their own doctor better questions.”

CTA

“It’s called the Fertility Foundations Kit, it’s $27, and it’s education, not medical advice. Tap Learn more.”
